info.name: JFrog Distribution REST API
info.description:
API for distributing release binaries to multiple remote locations. JFrog Distribution enables the creation of release bundles that are signed and distributed to Edge nodes, ensuring reliable and traceable software delivery across geographically distributed locations.

Contact Support:
 Name: JFrog
